.github/workflows/vldb-benchmark-comment.content:
name: VLDB Benchmark Comment on: workflow_run: workflows: [VLDB CI] types: [completed] permissions: actions: read contents: read issues: write pull-requests: read jobs: comment: name: comment-fts-benchmark if: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.event == 'pull_request' && github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' }} runs-on: ubuntu-latest steps: - name: Download FTS benchmark artifact id: download uses: actions/download-artifact@v8 continue-on-error: true with: name: vldb-fts-large-benchmark path: ${{ runner.temp }}/vldb-fts-large-benchmark run-id: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.id }} github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }} - name: Comment FTS benchmark report on PR if: ${{ always() }} shell: bash env: GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.VLDB_PR_COMMENT_TOKEN || github.token }} GH_REPO: ${{ github.repository }} PR_NUMBER_FROM_EVENT: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.pull_requests[0].number }} WORKFLOW_HEAD_REPO: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_repository.full_name }} WORKFLOW_HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }} RUN_URL: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.html_url }} ARTIFACT_DIR: ${{ runner.temp }}/vldb-fts-large-benchmark run: | set -euo pipefail REPORT_PATH="$ARTIFACT_DIR/report.txt" SCORE_PATH="$ARTIFACT_DIR/score.txt" AI_FUNCS_SCORE_PATH="$ARTIFACT_DIR/ai_funcs_score.txt" if [[ ! -f "$REPORT_PATH" && ! -f "$AI_FUNCS_SCORE_PATH" ]]; then echo "comment artifact has neither benchmark report nor ai_funcs score, skip PR comment" exit 0 fi PR_NUMBER="$PR_NUMBER_FROM_EVENT" if [[ ! "$PR_NUMBER" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then PR_NUMBER_PATH="$ARTIFACT_DIR/pr_number" if [[ ! -f "$PR_NUMBER_PATH" ]]; then echo "::warning::PR number missing from workflow_run event and artifact, skip PR comment" exit 0 fi PR_NUMBER="$(tr -d '[:space:]' < "$PR_NUMBER_PATH")" echo "workflow_run event did not include PR number, using artifact PR number: $PR_NUMBER" fi if [[ ! "$PR_NUMBER" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then echo "invalid PR number: $PR_NUMBER" exit 1 fi MARKER="" COMMENTS_API="https://api.github.com/repos/${GH_REPO}/issues/${PR_NUMBER}/comments" COMMENT_BODY="$RUNNER_TEMP/vldb_fts_benchmark_comment.json" COMMENTS_JSON="$RUNNER_TEMP/vldb_fts_benchmark_comments.json" RESPONSE_JSON="$RUNNER_TEMP/vldb_fts_benchmark_response.json" PR_JSON="$RUNNER_TEMP/vldb_fts_benchmark_pr.json" http_code="$(curl -sS -L -w '%{http_code}' -o "$PR_JSON" \ -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer ${GH_TOKEN}" \ -H "X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28" \ "https://api.github.com/repos/${GH_REPO}/pulls/${PR_NUMBER}" || true)" if [[ "$http_code" == "401" || "$http_code" == "403" ]]; then echo "::warning::skip PR comment: token cannot read pull request" cat "$PR_JSON" 2>/dev/null || true exit 0 fi if [[ ! "$http_code" =~ ^2 ]]; then echo "::warning::skip PR comment: failed to read pull request, HTTP $http_code" cat "$PR_JSON" 2>/dev/null || true exit 0 fi python3 - "$PR_JSON" "$WORKFLOW_HEAD_REPO" "$WORKFLOW_HEAD_SHA" <<'PY' import json import sys pr_path, workflow_head_repo, workflow_head_sha = sys.argv[1:4] with open(pr_path, encoding="utf-8") as f: pr = json.load(f) pr_head_repo = (pr.get("head", {}).get("repo") or {}).get("full_name") or "" pr_head_sha = pr.get("head", {}).get("sha") or "" if workflow_head_repo and pr_head_repo and workflow_head_repo != pr_head_repo: raise SystemExit( f"PR head repo mismatch: workflow_run={workflow_head_repo}, pr={pr_head_repo}" ) if workflow_head_sha and pr_head_sha and workflow_head_sha != pr_head_sha: print( f"::warning::PR head sha differs from workflow_run head_sha: " f"workflow_run={workflow_head_sha}, pr={pr_head_sha}" ) PY python3 - "$REPORT_PATH" "$SCORE_PATH" "$AI_FUNCS_SCORE_PATH" "$RUN_URL" "$MARKER" > "$COMMENT_BODY" <<'PY' import html import json from pathlib import Path import sys report_path, score_path, ai_funcs_score_path, run_url, marker = sys.argv[1:6] def read_optional(path): if path and Path(path).is_file(): return Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip() return "" report = read_optional(report_path) score = read_optional(score_path) ai_funcs_score = read_optional(ai_funcs_score_path) parts = [marker] if ai_funcs_score: parts += [ "### Document AI & IK Custom Dictionary Score", "", "
",
                  html.escape(ai_funcs_score),
                  "
", "", ] if report: parts += [ "### FTS Large Benchmark Score", "", "
",
                  html.escape(score or "score output not found"),
                  "
", "", "### FTS Large Benchmark Report", "", "
",
                  html.escape(report),
                  "
", "", ] parts.append(f"[Workflow run]({run_url})") body = "\n".join(parts) print(json.dumps({"body": body}, ensure_ascii=False)) PY http_code="$(curl -sS -L -w '%{http_code}' -o "$COMMENTS_JSON" \ -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer ${GH_TOKEN}" \ -H "X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28" \ "$COMMENTS_API" || true)" if [[ "$http_code" == "401" || "$http_code" == "403" ]]; then echo "::warning::skip PR comment: token cannot read comments" cat "$COMMENTS_JSON" 2>/dev/null || true exit 0 fi if [[ ! "$http_code" =~ ^2 ]]; then echo "::warning::skip PR comment: failed to list comments, HTTP $http_code" cat "$COMMENTS_JSON" 2>/dev/null || true exit 0 fi comment_id="$(python3 - "$COMMENTS_JSON" "$MARKER" <<'PY' import json import sys comments_path, marker = sys.argv[1:3] with open(comments_path, encoding="utf-8") as f: comments = json.load(f) for comment in comments: if marker in (comment.get("body") or ""): print(comment["id"]) break PY )" if [[ -n "$comment_id" ]]; then METHOD="PATCH" COMMENT_API="https://api.github.com/repos/${GH_REPO}/issues/comments/${comment_id}" else METHOD="POST" COMMENT_API="$COMMENTS_API" fi http_code="$(curl -sS -L -w '%{http_code}' -o "$RESPONSE_JSON" \ -X "$METHOD" \ -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer ${GH_TOKEN}" \ -H "X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28" \ --data-binary @"$COMMENT_BODY" \ "$COMMENT_API" || true)" if [[ "$http_code" == "401" || "$http_code" == "403" ]]; then echo "::warning::skip PR comment: token cannot write comments" cat "$RESPONSE_JSON" 2>/dev/null || true exit 0 fi if [[ ! "$http_code" =~ ^2 ]]; then echo "::warning::skip PR comment: failed to write comment, HTTP $http_code" cat "$RESPONSE_JSON" 2>/dev/null || true exit 0 fi echo "FTS benchmark PR comment posted"

.github/workflows/seekdb.yml.content:
# SeekDB CI - 执行下沉版（Native）
# setup 单次 checkout 并准备源码与 seekdb → 4 个并行 mysqltest job（各独立容器）→ collect 合并结果
name: SeekDB CI

on:
  workflow_call:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:
    branches: [master, develop]
    types: [opened, reopened, synchronize, ready_for_review]
    paths-ignore:
      - 'docs/**'
      - '.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/**'
      - '.github/pull_request_template.md'
      - 'README.md'
      - 'README_CN.md'
      - 'CONTRIBUTING.md'
  schedule:
    - cron: '30 9 * * *'

permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  MYSQLTEST_SLICES: "4"
  SEEKDB_BINARY_PATH: build_release/src/observer/seekdb
  SEEKDB_RESULT_NFS_ROOT: /data/storage/jenkins_on_k8s/results/seekdb
  # V1 integrity checks detect corruption but do not authenticate NFS writers.
  SEEKDB_CACHE_NFS_ROOT: /data/storage/jenkins_on_k8s/results/seekdb/_cache
  SEEKDB_CCACHE_MAX_SIZE: "3G"
  SEEKDB_PR_CACHE_MAX_BYTES: "3221225472"
  SEEKDB_PR_CACHE_GLOBAL_MAX_BYTES: "32212254720"
  SEEKDB_PR_CACHE_TTL_DAYS: "7"

jobs:
  seekdb-setup:
    name: setup
    if: ${{ github.repository_owner == 'oceanbase' && (github.event_name != 'pull_request' || !github.event.pull_request.draft) }}
    runs-on: arc-runner-k8s-ci-org
    container:
      image: harbor.oceanbase-dev.com/obrde-test/ob-actions-runner-worker:0.0.2
    steps:
      - name: Checkout source
        shell: bash
        env:
          SSH_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.SEEKDB_CI_CHECKOUT_KEY }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          if [[ -n "${SSH_PRIVATE_KEY:-}" ]]; then
            KEY_FILE="${RUNNER_TEMP}/seekdb-ci-checkout-key"
            trap 'rm -f "$KEY_FILE"' EXIT
            umask 077
            printf '%s\n' "$SSH_PRIVATE_KEY" | tr -d '\r' > "$KEY_FILE"
            export GIT_SSH_COMMAND="/usr/bin/ssh -i $KEY_FILE -o BatchMode=yes -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null"
            REMOTE_URL="ssh://git@ssh.github.com:443/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}.git"
            echo "SEEKDB_CI_CHECKOUT_KEY is available; using SSH checkout"
          else
            REMOTE_URL="${GITHUB_SERVER_URL}/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}.git"
            echo "SEEKDB_CI_CHECKOUT_KEY is unavailable; using HTTPS checkout"
          fi

          git init "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"
          git -C "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" remote remove origin 2>/dev/null || true
          git -C "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" remote add origin "$REMOTE_URL"
          for attempt in 1 2 3; do
            if git -C "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" fetch --no-tags --depth=1 origin "$GITHUB_SHA"; then
              break
            fi
            if [[ "$attempt" -eq 3 ]]; then
              echo "checkout fetch failed after $attempt attempts" >&2
              exit 1
            fi
            delay=$((attempt * 5))
            echo "checkout fetch attempt $attempt failed; retrying in ${delay}s" >&2
            sleep "$delay"
          done
          git -C "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" checkout --force --detach FETCH_HEAD
          git -C "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" clean -ffdx

      # Source 与 run_attempt 无关：下游 job 重跑时直接复用同一提交的快照。
      - name: Persist source snapshot to NFS
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          RUN_ROOT="${{ env.SEEKDB_RESULT_NFS_ROOT }}/${{ github.run_id }}"
          DEST_DIR="$RUN_ROOT/setup"
          SOURCE_ARCHIVE="${RUNNER_TEMP:-/tmp}/seekdb-ci-source.tar.zst"
          tar -C "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" --exclude='./.git' -cf - . \
            | zstd -f -q -T0 -o "$SOURCE_ARCHIVE"
          mkdir -p "$DEST_DIR"
          cp -f "$SOURCE_ARCHIVE" "$DEST_DIR/seekdb-ci-source.tar.zst"
          echo "source snapshot saved to $DEST_DIR/seekdb-ci-source.tar.zst"

      - name: Configure local cache paths
        shell: bash
        env:
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          SOURCE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          CACHE_ROOT="${RUNNER_TEMP:-/tmp}/seekdb-ci-cache"
          RUST_ROOT="${RUNNER_TEMP:-/tmp}/seekdb-rust"
          mkdir -p "$CACHE_ROOT/deps" "$CACHE_ROOT/ccache" "$CACHE_ROOT/ccache-tmp"
          mkdir -p "$RUST_ROOT/cargo" "$RUST_ROOT/rustup"
          {
            echo "SEEKDB_CACHE_LOCAL_ROOT=$CACHE_ROOT"
            echo "SEEKDB_RUST_CACHE_ROOT=$RUST_ROOT"
            echo "SEEKDB_PR_NUMBER=${PR_NUMBER:-}"
            echo "SEEKDB_SOURCE_SHA=$SOURCE_SHA"
            echo "DEP_CACHE_DIR=$CACHE_ROOT/deps"
            echo "CCACHE_DIR=$CACHE_ROOT/ccache"
            echo "CCACHE_TEMPDIR=$CACHE_ROOT/ccache-tmp"
            echo "CCACHE_BASEDIR=$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"
            echo "CCACHE_COMPILERCHECK=content"
            echo "CARGO_HOME=$RUST_ROOT/cargo"
            echo "RUSTUP_HOME=$RUST_ROOT/rustup"
          } >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "$RUST_ROOT/cargo/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

      - name: Restore build caches from NFS
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -u
          for kind in deps rustup cargo ccache; do
            if ! bash .github/script/seekdb/cache.sh restore "$kind"; then
              echo "cache restore failed for $kind; continuing with a cold cache"
            fi
          done
        continue-on-error: true

      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-rust
        with:
          # The rustup mirror below covers only rustup; this routes the crates
          # `cargo build --locked` downloads through the same mirror.
          crates-mirror: 'true'
          cache: 'false'
        env:
          RUSTUP_INIT_URL: https://rsproxy.cn/rustup-init.sh
          RUSTUP_DIST_SERVER: https://rsproxy.cn
          RUSTUP_UPDATE_ROOT: https://rsproxy.cn/rustup

      - name: Publish master Rust toolchain cache
        if: >-
          ${{ success() &&
              github.repository == 'oceanbase/seekdb' &&
              github.ref == 'refs/heads/master' &&
              (github.event_name == 'schedule' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch') }}
        shell: bash
        run: bash .github/script/seekdb/cache.sh publish-master rustup
        continue-on-error: true

      - name: Prepare (jobargs, run_jobs)
        shell: bash
        run: |
          chmod +x .github/script/seekdb/prepare.sh
          export GITHUB_RUN_ID="${{ github.run_id }}"
          export MYSQLTEST_SLICES="${{ env.MYSQLTEST_SLICES }}"
          export SEEKDB_TASK_DIR="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/seekdb_build/${{ github.run_id }}"
          .github/script/seekdb/prepare.sh

      - name: Compile
        id: compile
        shell: bash
        run: |
          chmod +x .github/script/seekdb/compile.sh
          export GITHUB_RUN_ID="${{ github.run_id }}"
          WS="${{ github.workspace }}"
          if [[ ! -f "$WS/build.sh" ]] && [[ -f "$(pwd)/build.sh" ]]; then
            export GITHUB_WORKSPACE="$(pwd)"
          else
            export GITHUB_WORKSPACE="$WS"
          fi
          export SEEKDB_TASK_DIR="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/seekdb_build/${{ github.run_id }}"
          export FORWARDING_HOST="${{ vars.FORWARDING_HOST || '' }}"
          export PATH="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/deps/3rd/usr/local/oceanbase/devtools/bin:$PATH"
          .github/script/seekdb/compile.sh

      - name: Publish master build caches
        if: >-
          ${{ always() &&
              github.repository == 'oceanbase/seekdb' &&
              github.ref == 'refs/heads/master' &&
              (github.event_name == 'schedule' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch') }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -u
          for kind in deps cargo ccache; do
            bash .github/script/seekdb/cache.sh publish-master "$kind" || true
          done
        continue-on-error: true

      - name: Publish PR ccache delta
        if: >-
          ${{ always() &&
              github.event_name == 'pull_request' &&
              github.event.pull_request.number != null }}
        shell: bash
        run: bash .github/script/seekdb/cache.sh publish-pr-ccache
        continue-on-error: true

      - name: Garbage collect shared caches
        if: >-
          ${{ always() &&
              github.repository == 'oceanbase/seekdb' &&
              github.ref == 'refs/heads/master' &&
              github.event_name == 'schedule' }}
        shell: bash
        run: bash .github/script/seekdb/cache.sh gc
        continue-on-error: true

      - name: Prepare mysqltest runtime
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          SEEKDB_BINARY="${SEEKDB_BINARY_PATH:?}"
          if [[ ! -x "$SEEKDB_BINARY" ]]; then
            echo "seekdb missing or not executable: $SEEKDB_BINARY"
            exit 1
          fi
          CLIENT_ROOT="deps/3rd/u01/obclient"
          if [[ ! -x "$CLIENT_ROOT/bin/obclient" || ! -x "$CLIENT_ROOT/bin/mysqltest" ]]; then
            echo "obclient or mysqltest missing under $CLIENT_ROOT/bin"
            exit 1
          fi
          RUNTIME_DIR="${RUNNER_TEMP:-/tmp}/seekdb-mysqltest-runtime-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}"
          mkdir -p "$RUNTIME_DIR/obclient"
          cp -L -f "$SEEKDB_BINARY" "$RUNTIME_DIR/seekdb"
          cp -a "$CLIENT_ROOT/." "$RUNTIME_DIR/obclient/"
          tar -C "$RUNTIME_DIR" -cf - seekdb obclient | zstd -f -q -T0 -o seekdb-mysqltest-runtime.tar.zst
          echo "runtime size: $(stat -c%s seekdb-mysqltest-runtime.tar.zst 2>/dev/null || stat -f%z seekdb-mysqltest-runtime.tar.zst 2>/dev/null) bytes"
      # Runtime 与 run_attempt 无关：仅重跑失败 job 时 setup 可能跳过，因此优先使用稳定路径。
      - name: Persist mysqltest runtime to NFS
        shell: bash
        run: |
          RUN_ROOT="${{ env.SEEKDB_RESULT_NFS_ROOT }}/${{ github.run_id }}"
          DEST_DIR="$RUN_ROOT/setup"
          mkdir -p "$DEST_DIR"
          cp -f seekdb-mysqltest-runtime.tar.zst "$DEST_DIR/"
          echo "mysqltest runtime saved to $DEST_DIR/seekdb-mysqltest-runtime.tar.zst"
  seekdb-mysqltest:
    name: mysqltest-slice-${{ matrix.slice }}
    needs: seekdb-setup
    runs-on: arc-runner-k8s-ci-org
    container:
      image: harbor.oceanbase-dev.com/obrde-test/ob-actions-runner-worker:0.0.2
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        slice: [0, 1, 2, 3]
    steps:
      - name: Restore source snapshot (from NFS)
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          SOURCE_ARCHIVE="${{ env.SEEKDB_RESULT_NFS_ROOT }}/${{ github.run_id }}/setup/seekdb-ci-source.tar.zst"
          if [[ ! -f "$SOURCE_ARCHIVE" ]]; then
            echo "source snapshot not found: $SOURCE_ARCHIVE"
            exit 1
          fi
          mkdir -p "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"
          zstd -d -q -c "$SOURCE_ARCHIVE" | tar -xf - -C "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"

      - name: Place mysqltest runtime (from NFS)
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -eo pipefail
          RUN_ROOT="${{ env.SEEKDB_RESULT_NFS_ROOT }}/${{ github.run_id }}"
          ATT="${{ github.run_attempt }}"
          RUNTIME_ARCHIVE=""
          if [[ -f "$RUN_ROOT/setup/seekdb-mysqltest-runtime.tar.zst" ]]; then
            RUNTIME_ARCHIVE="$RUN_ROOT/setup/seekdb-mysqltest-runtime.tar.zst"
          elif [[ -f "$RUN_ROOT/attempt-${ATT}/setup/seekdb-mysqltest-runtime.tar.zst" ]]; then
            RUNTIME_ARCHIVE="$RUN_ROOT/attempt-${ATT}/setup/seekdb-mysqltest-runtime.tar.zst"
          else
            shopt -s nullglob
            _fb=( "$RUN_ROOT"/attempt-*/setup/seekdb-mysqltest-runtime.tar.zst )
            shopt -u nullglob
            if (( ${#_fb[@]} > 0 )); then
              RUNTIME_ARCHIVE=$(printf '%s\n' "${_fb[@]}" | xargs ls -t | head -1)
            fi
          fi
          if [[ -n "$RUNTIME_ARCHIVE" && -f "$RUNTIME_ARCHIVE" ]]; then
            echo "Using runtime: $RUNTIME_ARCHIVE"
            mkdir -p .seekdb_runtime
            zstd -d -q -c "$RUNTIME_ARCHIVE" | tar -xf - -C .seekdb_runtime
          else
            echo "mysqltest runtime not found on NFS under $RUN_ROOT"
            exit 1
          fi
          test -x .seekdb_runtime/seekdb
          test -x .seekdb_runtime/obclient/bin/obclient
          test -x .seekdb_runtime/obclient/bin/mysqltest
      - name: Run mysqltest slice
        shell: bash
        run: |
          chmod +x .github/script/seekdb/mysqltest_slice.sh
          export GITHUB_RUN_ID="${{ github.run_id }}"
          export SEEKDB_TASK_DIR="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/seekdb_build/${{ github.run_id }}/slice_${{ matrix.slice }}"
          export SLICE_IDX=${{ matrix.slice }} SLICES="${{ env.MYSQLTEST_SLICES }}"
          export SEEKDB_RUNTIME_DIR="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/.seekdb_runtime"
          export SEEKDB_BINARY="$SEEKDB_RUNTIME_DIR/seekdb"
          mkdir -p "$SEEKDB_TASK_DIR"
          .github/script/seekdb/mysqltest_slice.sh

      - name: Persist slice result to NFS
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          TASK_DIR="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/seekdb_build/${{ github.run_id }}/slice_${{ matrix.slice }}"
          DEST_DIR="${{ env.SEEKDB_RESULT_NFS_ROOT }}/${{ github.run_id }}/attempt-${{ github.run_attempt }}/slices/slice_${{ matrix.slice }}"
          mkdir -p "$DEST_DIR"
          if [[ -f "$TASK_DIR/seekdb_result.json" ]]; then
            cp -f "$TASK_DIR/seekdb_result.json" "$DEST_DIR/"
          else
            echo "skip copying slice result: seekdb_result.json not found"
          fi
          if [[ -d "$TASK_DIR/failures" ]]; then
            mkdir -p "$DEST_DIR/failures"
            cp -a "$TASK_DIR/failures/." "$DEST_DIR/failures/"
          fi
        continue-on-error: true

      - name: Job summary (logs hint)
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          TASK_DIR="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/seekdb_build/${{ github.run_id }}/slice_${{ matrix.slice }}"
          if [[ -d "$TASK_DIR/failures" ]]; then
            echo "### Slice ${{ matrix.slice }} failure diagnostics saved" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
            echo "Saved under \`${{ env.SEEKDB_RESULT_NFS_ROOT }}/${{ github.run_id }}/attempt-${{ github.run_attempt }}/slices/slice_${{ matrix.slice }}/failures/\`." >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          fi
  seekdb-collect:
    # 仅在 4 个 mysqltest slice 都跑完（成功或失败）时执行；若 mysqltest 被 skip 则不跑
    if: ${{ always() && needs.seekdb-mysqltest.result != 'skipped' }}
    name: collect
    needs: seekdb-mysqltest
    runs-on: arc-runner-k8s-ci-org
    container:
      image: harbor.oceanbase-dev.com/obrde-test/ob-actions-runner-worker:0.0.2
    steps:
      - name: Restore source snapshot (from NFS)
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          SOURCE_ARCHIVE="${{ env.SEEKDB_RESULT_NFS_ROOT }}/${{ github.run_id }}/setup/seekdb-ci-source.tar.zst"
          if [[ ! -f "$SOURCE_ARCHIVE" ]]; then
            echo "source snapshot not found: $SOURCE_ARCHIVE"
            exit 1
          fi
          mkdir -p "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"
          zstd -d -q -c "$SOURCE_ARCHIVE" | tar -xf - -C "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"

      - name: Collect slice results from NFS
        shell: bash
        run: |
          RUN_ROOT="${{ env.SEEKDB_RESULT_NFS_ROOT }}/${{ github.run_id }}"
          ATT="${{ github.run_attempt }}"
          SLICES="${{ env.MYSQLTEST_SLICES }}"
          mkdir -p slice_results
          for (( slice=0; slice<SLICES; slice++ )); do
            SOURCE_RESULT=""
            SOURCE_ATTEMPT=""
            for (( attempt=ATT; attempt>=1; attempt-- )); do
              CANDIDATE="$RUN_ROOT/attempt-$attempt/slices/slice_$slice/seekdb_result.json"
              if [[ -f "$CANDIDATE" ]]; then
                SOURCE_RESULT="$CANDIDATE"
                SOURCE_ATTEMPT="$attempt"
                break
              fi
            done
            if [[ -n "$SOURCE_RESULT" ]]; then
              mkdir -p "slice_results/slice_$slice"
              cp -f "$SOURCE_RESULT" "slice_results/slice_$slice/seekdb_result.json"
              echo "slice $slice result loaded from attempt-$SOURCE_ATTEMPT"
            else
              echo "slice $slice result not found under $RUN_ROOT/attempt-*"
            fi
          done
      - name: Merge results and persist
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set +e
          python3 .github/script/seekdb/mysqltest_for_seekdb.py merge \
            --results-dir slice_results \
            --slice-count "${{ env.MYSQLTEST_SLICES }}" \
            --run-id "${{ github.run_id }}" \
            --output seekdb_result.json
          MERGE_RET=$?
          set -e
          DEST_DIR="${{ env.SEEKDB_RESULT_NFS_ROOT }}/${{ github.run_id }}/attempt-${{ github.run_attempt }}/collect"
          mkdir -p "$DEST_DIR"
          cp -f seekdb_result.json "$DEST_DIR/"
          echo "seekdb_result.json saved to $DEST_DIR/seekdb_result.json"
          exit "$MERGE_RET"

# MiniVectorDB 公开自测题包

适用于 `2026-competition-round2`。本包共 **20 个公开样例、95 条 SQL**，统一放在 `cases/` 目录，按清单顺序从简单操作逐步验证持久化、索引和事务能力。

## 公开用例

| 用例 | 检查目标 |
| --- | --- |
| sql_crud | 一条记录的插入、查询、更新与删除 |
| sql_comparisons | 整数比较和 AND 条件 |
| sql_ordering | 无并列项的升降序与 LIMIT |
| sql_empty | 空表查询、空表删除 |
| sql_primary_key | 拒绝重复主键，保留原记录 |
| sql_unicode | 中文字符串写入与读取，不混入长度边界和字符排序 |
| sql_bigint | 超过 JavaScript 安全整数范围的 BIGINT 精确读写，不混入溢出 |
| sql_unsupported | 对题目不支持的 ALTER TABLE 返回错误 |
| storage_restart | 一条自动提交记录在正常重启后保留 |
| vector_euclidean | 单条二维向量的欧氏距离，不混入更新、过滤或索引 |
| transaction_commit | 普通表事务修改提交后可见，不依赖向量或重启 |
| transaction_rollback | 普通表事务修改回滚后恢复，不依赖向量或重启 |
| storage_mutations | 更新、删除和向量修改在重启后保持一致 |
| storage_multiple_tables | 多表定义和记录的持久化 |
| vector_ties_and_filter | 先过滤后 TopK，距离并列按主键排序 |
| vector_float32 | 存储与距离计算的 float32 语义 |
| vector_index_maintenance | 建索引后增删改、重启及模式切换 |
| transaction_failed_insert | 事务中多行插入失败的原子性及后续提交 |
| transaction_autocommit_atomic | 自动提交语句失败不能留下部分数据 |
| transaction_shutdown_rollback | 正常关闭时回滚未提交事务 |

## 格式与执行约定

这是 **mysqltest 风格的 SQL/预期断言题包**，不是 MySQL 官方 mysqltest 的原生可执行格式，不要求 MySQL 网络服务。

- `manifest.json`：每个样例的 id、类别及 test/result 相对路径。
- `cases/*.test`：UTF-8，每个非空行是一条完整 SQL 或驱动指令。
- 同名 `.result`：JSON 数组，只与 SQL 按顺序一一对应，驱动指令不占断言位置。

每个用例从独立的空数据库和数据目录开始，不能把全部文件拼成一次执行。用例内 `--restart` 必须复用原数据目录；不要因重启清空数据。

| 驱动指令 | 含义 |
| --- | --- |
| `--restart` | 正常关闭并等待退出，再用相同数据目录启动；关闭须回滚未提交事务 |
| `--mode ann` | 后续向量请求采用 ann 模式；每个用例最初为 exact |

指令不是 SQL。本包没有强杀指令。ANN 小数据样例按对应 result 的明确结果检查，不等于正式随机 ANN 的完整召回率验证。进程通信采用标准输入/输出 JSONL 协议；详见根目录 STDIO_PROTOCOL.md。配套公开自测驱动位于 protocol_check/run.py。

断言规则：

- `{}`：SQL 必须成功，不额外要求特定结果字段；不表示可以忽略错误。
- `error`：SQL 必须失败，值是错误语义名，如 `duplicate_key`。当前未冻结错误码映射的配置至少要求非空错误码；正式映射以题包为准。预期错误后继续执行后续语句。
- `affected_rows`：受影响记录数，精确比较。
- `columns`：查询列名及其顺序，精确比较。
- `rows`：按顺序比较查询结果；`unordered: true` 时改用多重集合比较，重复行不可丢失。

整数、字符串精确匹配；浮点比较绝对/相对容差均为 `1e-5`。向量先存为 float32，L2_DISTANCE 返回欧氏距离而非距离平方，例如 `[3,4]` 与 `[0,0]` 的距离为 5。

本包不提供数据库实现。请实现正常执行与错误处理，而非预存样例答案。基础样例已简化，不能用评测仓库中的同名正式用例替代它们，须读取本目录中的实际文件。

## 正式验收要求仍然公开

公开样例通过不代表完整功能准入通过。正式用例共 29 个，全部通过才进入性能与 Agent 评分；组织方另保留 9 个用例的具体输入、操作序列、数据生成参数和预期结果。正式评测并非只运行保留的 9 个。

以下功能仍属于正式要求，不能因本包没有相应完整用例而省略：

- 拒绝 NaN、Infinity、维度错误、float32 溢出等非法向量。
- 失败语句不能部分生效；显式事务之前的成功修改仍可提交或回滚。
- 已确认提交在进程强杀后保留，未提交修改不部分生效；恢复途中再次退出仍能恢复。
- 能处理超过内存限额的数据，不能只依赖全量常驻内存。
- ANN 必须满足过滤、有效 ID、无重复及题包规定的召回率，索引更新不能破坏事务语义。

隐藏的是测试数据，而非功能要求。正式题目的完整语法、资源预算和冻结配置以统一题包为准。


## JSON 通信协议与自测入口

请先阅读 [STDIO_PROTOCOL.md](../STDIO_PROTOCOL.md) 和 [协议自测说明](../protocol_check/README.md)。
容器必须主动输出一行 `{"type":"ready"}`，随后逐行读取 execute/shutdown JSON 请求，
逐行返回含相同 id 和布尔 ok 的响应。每条输出须换行并 flush；日志写 stderr。
纯文本 READY、直接输入 SQL、文本表格均不符合正式协议。

本目录 .test 是待执行 SQL/.result 是预期断言，不是实际通信报文；驱动负责封装请求。
公开断言中的 `{}` 也要求成功响应含 id、ok:true。

在仓库根目录先运行握手检查，再运行公开用例（替换镜像名）：

```bash
export VECTORDB_IMAGE='你的镜像名:标签'
python3 protocol_check/run.py --image "$VECTORDB_IMAGE" --handshake-only --output "protocol-results/handshake-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)"
python3 protocol_check/run.py --image "$VECTORDB_IMAGE" --output "protocol-results/public-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)"
```

每次使用新的产物目录。握手通过不代表SQL正确；公开用例通过不等于正式功能准入通过。
example_stdio.py仅提供通信骨架，SQL执行尚未实现，不可作为数据库实现直接提交。

protocol_readme.content:
# JSON 协议自测工具

Python 3.9+，无需 pip 依赖。Docker 测试需本机 Docker 权限。
本目录随题包提供，不依赖组织方评测仓库，不包含隐藏测试、基线、评分、平台凭据或回执接口。
完整协议见根目录 `STDIO_PROTOCOL.md`。

## 第一步：只检查启动和关闭

在题包根目录执行，替换为自己的已构建镜像：

```bash
export VECTORDB_IMAGE='你的镜像名:标签'
python3 protocol_check/run.py --image "$VECTORDB_IMAGE" \
  --handshake-only --output "protocol-results/handshake-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)"
```

工具先启动容器，等待程序主动输出 ready，再发送 shutdown。它不会先发送 SQL 来诱导程序输出 ready，
因此能发现“等输入才 ready”、没有换行或没有 flush 等问题。
解析失败时显示 stdout 错误行前240字节，stderr 单独保存；不要在协议输出中打印密钥等敏感信息。

## 第二步：运行一个公开用例

```bash
python3 protocol_check/run.py --image "$VECTORDB_IMAGE" \
  --case sql_crud --output "protocol-results/crud-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)"
```

## 第三步：运行题包中全部公开用例

```bash
python3 protocol_check/run.py --image "$VECTORDB_IMAGE" \
  --output "protocol-results/public-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)"
```

工具读取当前题包 `mysqltest/manifest.json` 与其中列出的 test/result 文件；不拿内部同名用例替代公开用例。
每个用例独立数据卷，同一用例的 `--restart` 复用卷，`--mode ann` 改变后续请求模式。
第一个超时后停止执行剩余用例，标记 SKIPPED；清理容器、保留报告和日志。

输出目录必须是新目录。`result.json` 中 `passed=true` 才表示本次选中的检查通过；进程退出码0表示通过，1表示失败。
只检查握手通过不代表 SQL 正确；公开用例通过不代表正式29个用例或性能/Agent评审通过。

`config.json` 使用当前判题资源与基础比较参数：启动120秒、单请求60秒、普通用例600秒，
2 CPU、2 GiB、128 PID，绝对/相对浮点容差均为1e-5。正式平台配置更新时应同步题包。
本地可用 `--config` 指定配置，但放宽本地参数不能改变正式判题要求。

## 通信层骨架

`example_stdio.py` 演示序列化、flush、请求分发、错误响应和shutdown。
它**没有实现数据库**：execute总是返回NOT_IMPLEMENTED，不能用于通过SQL用例，更不是参考数据库答案。
请接入自己的恢复、SQL执行、事务回滚和持久化逻辑；stdout不输出调试日志。

可用可信本地进程演示握手：

```bash
python3 protocol_check/run.py \
  --command '["python3","protocol_check/example_stdio.py"]' \
  --handshake-only --output "protocol-results/example-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)"
```

`--command` 不提供容器隔离，只用于自己的可信程序。需要临时数据目录时，在 argv 中使用 `{data_dir}` 占位符。
正式提交前必须再测实际Docker镜像，检查默认启动参数、依赖和只读根文件系统下的行为。

## 公开断言与实际响应的区别

`.test` 的SQL必须包装成execute JSON；`.result` 只是结果断言，不是完整通信报文。
断言 `{}` 仍要求 `ok:true`；断言包含 `error` 时要求 `ok:false` 和非空 `error.code`。
BIGINT必须保持整数精度，列顺序/行数/重复行不能丢失，向量使用float32语义。

本工具复用了当前判题器的通信和结果比较语义。工具不会帮学生把READY或纯SQL协议自动转换成JSON协议。

readme.content:
# PowerContext 2026 参赛与公开自测

从本分支的产品代码开始实现题目。代码基线为 `9db1753434162c0aa7c9f1189a1722e617880a52`（PowerContext v1.2.0）；`competition/` 提供题面、公开样例和公开行为测试。实现仍放在产品的 `src/` 中。

## 选择题目

| 赛题 | 分值 | 题面 | 本地自测 |
| --- | ---: | --- | --- |
| 一：准备 PowerContext 参赛仓库 | 10 | [仓库准备](challenges/setup-00-repository-fork/instruction.md) | `make check-baseline` |
| 二：CSV 行级采集与原始记录回查 | 20 | [CSV](challenges/source-01-table-evidence/instruction.md) | `make test-csv` |
| 三：Pi 会话分支采集与断点恢复 | 20 | [Pi](challenges/source-02-pi-history/instruction.md) | `make test-pi` |
| 四：财报 PDF 全文解析与证据页检索 | 50 | [PDF](challenges/source-03-pdf-retrieval/instruction.md) | `make test-pdf` |
| 五：HTTP 重排服务接入与跨批次排序 | 20 | [HTTP 重排](challenges/retrieval-01-reranking/instruction.md) | `make test-rerank` |
| 六：上下文增量传输与完整重建 | 20 | [增量上下文](challenges/context-02-incremental-pack/instruction.md) | `make test-incremental` |
| 七：按新增来源条目数触发记忆处理 | 20 | [数量触发](challenges/processing-01-count-trigger/instruction.md) | `make test-count-trigger` |
| 八：Embedding 并发请求合并与向量缓存 | 20 | [Embedding](challenges/memory-02-embedding-batches/instruction.md) | `make test-embedding` |
| 九：来源撤回后的记忆停用与恢复 | 20 | [来源生命周期](challenges/memory-01-source-lifecycle/instruction.md) | `make test-lifecycle` |
| 十：按查询和预算选择原文证据 | 20 | [证据选择](challenges/context-01-evidence-selection/instruction.md) | `make test-evidence` |
| 十一：seekdb 混合检索的单 SQL 候选查询 | 20 | [混合检索](challenges/retrieval-02-hybrid-search/instruction.md) | `make test-hybrid` |
| 合计 | **240** | | |

表中的命令在 `competition/` 运行。每道代码题按完整验收是否通过计分。本地命令只给出公开测试结果，不生成或上报比赛成绩，公开测试通过也不代表已经满足题面全部质量与性能要求。

## 在本机运行公开测试

环境要求为 Linux x86_64、Python 3.12 和 uv。所有测试依赖固定在 [requirements.txt](requirements.txt)，不需要模型 API Key、平台 Token。seekdb 测试使用嵌入式 pylibseekdb，无需另行部署数据库服务。

从产品仓库根目录执行：

```bash
make -C competition install
make -C competition check-baseline
make -C competition test-csv
```

安装依赖需要网络；测试使用本地样例、固定响应和临时数据库，不调用在线模型。数量触发题会运行本地 HTTP 测试服务，并包含等待与恢复场景，执行时间较长，期间不要中断进程。

运行全部公开代码题测试，各题使用独立 Python 进程，避免嵌入式数据库的进程内状态相互影响；某题失败后仍继续运行其余题，最后返回非零状态：

```bash
make -C competition test
```

如需对另一个产品 checkout 运行测试，只切换产品目录：

```bash
make -C competition test-pi PRODUCT=/absolute/path/to/product
```

测试从该目录的 `src/` 加载实现，不从已安装的其他 PowerContext 版本加载。pytest 输出 `FAILED` 或导入错误都表示本轮自测未通过；基线尚未实现的接口出现导入错误属于预期起点。不要通过跳过测试或改动测试文件消除失败。

## 使用统一 Docker 环境

宿主不便准备 Python 依赖时，在安装 Docker 与 Compose 后执行：

```bash
make -C competition docker-build
make -C competition docker-test
```

构建阶段下载固定依赖，运行阶段关闭外部网络。启动脚本为嵌入式 seekdb 配置仅容器内可用的虚拟地址，随后切换为普通用户执行测试，不连接外部网络。容器配额为 1 CPU、2 GiB，产品源码和公开测试均只读挂载，数据库及临时文件写入容器临时目录。Docker 环境支持 Linux x86_64；跨架构模拟的耗时不能用于判断性能是否达标。

只运行某一题也可直接使用 pytest：

```bash
cd competition
docker compose run --rm selftest python -m pytest -q \
  -c /selftest/pytest.ini --confcutdir=/selftest \
  /selftest/challenges/source-01-table-evidence/acceptance
```

## 准备提测

按参赛指南导入 PowerContext 并保留提交历史，私有仓库须授予平台读取权限；已有公开 Fork 也可使用。仓库准备题接受任一分支包含冻结基线，不要求新建特定名称的分支。`check-baseline` 只检查本地历史，不证明 GitHub 权限或仓库归属，也不覆盖官方 Fork 关联这一替代条件。

一次提测可以包含全部代码题的实现。提交实际仓库、分支及 commit；未指定版本时，平台将使用默认分支的实际版本。提交前确认默认分支包含自己的实现。代码题只加载 `src/`，不能通过修改本目录的测试、数据或依赖改变评测结果。

公开包中的 PDF、CSV、SciFact 和会话数据保留各自来源、归属和许可，见对应 `workload/` 文件。样例中的代码、链接及历史命令只作为输入文字，不需要执行。

protocol_run.content:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Interactive JSONL handshake and public SQL checks; no platform callbacks."""
import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path
import signal
import subprocess
import sys
import time

from _transport import Session, strict_json
from _assertions import assert_response

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent


def within(root, relative):
    path = (root / relative).resolve(strict=True)
    path.relative_to(root.resolve())
    return path


def check_case(session, case, package, config):
    expectations = strict_json(within(package, case['result']).read_text())
    statements = within(package, case['test']).read_text().splitlines()
    index, mode = 0, 'exact'
    for line_number, text in enumerate(statements, 1):
        sql = text.strip()
        if not sql or sql.startswith('#'):
            continue
        if sql == '--restart':
            session.shutdown()
            session.start()
        elif sql in ('--mode exact', '--mode ann'):
            mode = sql.split()[1]
        elif sql.startswith('--'):
            raise ValueError(f'unsupported public directive: {sql}')
        else:
            if index >= len(expectations):
                raise ValueError('missing expected result')
            response = session.request(sql, mode)
            try:
                assert_response(response, expectations[index], config)
            except AssertionError as exc:
                raise AssertionError(f'line {line_number}: {sql}: {exc}') from exc
            index += 1
    if index != len(expectations):
        raise ValueError('SQL/result count mismatch')


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    target = parser.add_mutually_exclusive_group(required=True)
    target.add_argument('--image', help='built student Docker image (recommended)')
    target.add_argument('--command', help='trusted local development only: JSON argv; {data_dir} placeholder supported')
    parser.add_argument('--handshake-only', action='store_true', help='check ready and shutdown, without SQL')
    parser.add_argument('--case', action='append', help='public case ID; repeat to select multiple cases')
    parser.add_argument('--package', type=Path, default=ROOT.parent/'mysqltest')
    parser.add_argument('--config', type=Path, default=ROOT/'config.json')
    parser.add_argument('--output', type=Path, required=True, help='new directory for reports and stderr logs')
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    config = strict_json(args.config.read_text())
    command = strict_json(args.command) if args.command else None
    if command is not None and (not isinstance(command, list) or not command
            or any(not isinstance(x, str) for x in command)):
        parser.error('--command must be a nonempty JSON array of strings')
    if args.handshake_only and args.case:
        parser.error('--handshake-only and --case cannot be combined')
    if args.handshake_only:
        cases = [{'id': 'handshake'}]
    else:
        manifest = strict_json((args.package/'manifest.json').read_text())
        cases = manifest['cases']
        if args.case:
            unknown = set(args.case) - {case['id'] for case in cases}
            if unknown:
                parser.error('unknown public case: '+', '.join(sorted(unknown)))
            cases = [case for case in cases if case['id'] in args.case]
    if not cases:
        parser.error('no public cases selected')
    args.output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    results, aborted = [], None
    for case in cases:
        if aborted:
            results.append(dict(id=case['id'], status='SKIPPED', message=aborted))
            continue
        before = time.monotonic()
        row = dict(id=case['id'], status='PASS', message='')
        session = None
        try:
            session = Session(config, args.output/(case['id']+'.stderr.log'),
                              image=args.image, command=command)
            session.start()
            if not args.handshake_only:
                check_case(session, case, args.package, config)
            session.shutdown()
        except KeyboardInterrupt:
            row.update(status='ERROR', message='interrupted by operator')
            aborted = 'not run after interruption'
        except (TimeoutError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired) as exc:
            row.update(status='TIMEOUT', message=str(exc))
            aborted = 'not run after first timeout'
        except Exception as exc:
            row.update(status='FAIL', message=str(exc))
        finally:
            if session is not None:
                try:
                    session.close()
                except Exception as exc:
                    row.update(status='ERROR', message=row['message']+'; cleanup failed: '+str(exc))
                    aborted = 'not run after cleanup failure'
        row['duration_ms'] = round((time.monotonic()-before)*1000)
        results.append(row)
        print(f"{row['id']}: {row['status']} {row['message']}", flush=True)
        (args.output/'cases.json').write_text(json.dumps(results, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)+'\n')
    passed = all(row['status']=='PASS' for row in results)
    report = dict(scope='public-protocol-check', passed=passed, cases=results,
                  note='Local diagnostic only; no performance/Agent scores or platform callbacks.')
    (args.output/'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)+'\n')
    print(f"Report: {args.output/'result.json'}")
    return 0 if passed else 1


if __name__ == '__main__':
    def terminate(signum, frame):
        raise KeyboardInterrupt('terminated')
    signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, terminate)
    sys.exit(main())
